answer_1.quote: this reproduction experiment sought to obtain individual preferences of participants when presented with hedged and non-hedged texts when communicating exams results for hypothetical exams results.

answer_4.quote: a human evaluation was conducted between NLG texts containing hedge phrases and those that do not
answer_4.guideline: participants were asked to state whether they felt the results were good or not for the student (Yes, No, Maybe) and a preference between the two texts A and B. This was done using a Likert scale which ran from -3 for Text A to +3 for Text B. If both texts were considered by a participant to be the same then a score of 0 was given. The participants were asked to provide free text comments on why they made their particular choice of text.
